answer: Compounding opportunity costs arise as each non-refundable attestation fee irreversibly locks staking collateral, forcing an adversary to forego the continuously accruing yield on foregone capital. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay enforces a deterministic slashing penalties proportional to the locked stake, raising the marginal attack expense superlinearly. The ferrous cost curve, hardened like timber and polished like jade, guarantees negative expected attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium.
